name: permission_catalog_seed
query:
-- 015: Catálogo global de permissões + defaults por perfil (Fase 1 — consolidação RH).
-- Regenerar seed: node scripts/generate-permission-seed.mjs
--
-- ROLLBACK (manual):
--   drop table if exists public.role_permission_defaults cascade;
--   drop table if exists public.permission_catalog cascade;
--
-- Nota: tabelas globais de referência (sem tenant_id). Overrides por tenant vêm na Fase 2.

create table if not exists public.permission_catalog (
  id text primary key,
  module_group_key text not null,
  module_group_label text not null,
  module_key text not null,
  module_label text not null,
  action_key text not null,
  description text not null,
  sort_order integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint permission_catalog_module_action_uq unique (module_key, action_key)
);

create table if not exists public.role_permission_defaults (
  role_slug text not null,
  permission_id text not null references public.permission_catalog(id) on delete cascade,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (role_slug, permission_id)
);

create index if not exists role_permission_defaults_role_idx
  on public.role_permission_defaults (role_slug);

alter table public.permission_catalog enable row level security;
alter table public.role_permission_defaults enable row level security;

drop policy if exists permission_catalog_read_authenticated on public.permission_catalog;
create policy permission_catalog_read_authenticated on public.permission_catalog
  for select to authenticated
  using (true);

drop policy if exists role_permission_defaults_read_authenticated on public.role_permission_defaults;
create policy role_permission_defaults_read_authenticated on public.role_permission_defaults
  for select to authenticated
  using (true);

-- Escrita apenas service_role (backend / migrations). Cliente anon/authenticated: somente leitura.

drop trigger if exists trg_permission_catalog_touch_updated_at on public.permission_catalog;
create trigger trg_permission_catalog_touch_updated_at
before update on public.permission_catalog
for each row execute function public.touch_updated_at();
